items.title: Brandon Aiyuk: Turns in reinstatement paperwork
items.text:
Aiyuk, who who is currently is on the 49ers' Reserve/Left Squad list, has turned in paperwork to be reinstated, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tyler Huntley: Reportedly out for season with turf toe
items.text:
Huntley (toe) has reportedly sustained a season-ending turf toe injury, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tyler Allgeier: Set for lead-back duties
items.text:
Allgeier is slated to work as Arizona's No. 1 running back for at least the next four weeks after Jeremiyah Love (ankle) was placed on injured reserve Tuesday, Darren Urban of the team's official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
